T: Hooked on a feeling. Hungry for snacks.
D: A scrappy band of misfits teams up to keep a powerful orb out of a fanatic's hands.
P: Serve the snacks when Quill puts his mixtape on.
S: Awesome Mix Vol. 1, the tape his mum made him in 1988

Crisp golden pastry rolls stuffed with pepperoni, mozzarella and pizza sauce, baked until bubbling, with a hot honey and chilli marinara for dunking. Heat the oven to 200C. Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into 8 rectangles each. Put 1 tsp pizza sauce, 2 slices pepperoni and a pinch of grated mozzarella and oregano on each, roll up and pinch the ends closed. Lay seam down on lined trays, brush with beaten egg and scatter with parmesan. Bake 15 to 18 minutes until puffed and golden. Warm 300ml napoli sauce with 1 tbsp honey and a big pinch of chilli flakes to dip.
the bar inside a giant skull
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a sticky purple glaze of blackberry, soy, chilli and honey.
Groot charred broccolini with whipped feta
I am Groot, regrowing in his little pot

Broccolini and green beans blanched, then charred in a smoking pan with garlic and chilli, piled over whipped feta with lemon and toasted almonds. Blend 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and a little olive oil until smooth and spread on a platter. Blanch 2 bunches broccolini and 200g green beans for 1 minute, drain and pat dry. Char in a smoking hot pan with olive oil for 3 to 4 minutes, adding 2 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli flakes at the end. Pile over the feta, squeeze over lemon and scatter with toasted flaked almonds.
M: Pork ribs rubbed and slow-baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed under the grill with a smoky barbecue sauce, with corn and slaw.

Tender beef and pork meatloaf lacquered in a sticky gochujang, brown sugar and tomato glaze, sliced thick on creamy mash with buttered corn and onion gravy. Soak 60g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk. Mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 1 tsp mustard and salt. Shape into a loaf on a lined tray. Mix 100ml tomato sauce, 1 tbsp gochujang, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar, brush half over and bake at 180C for 50 minutes, adding the rest halfway. Rest 10 minutes. Serve with mash, buttered corn kernels and gravy from 1 sliced onion, 300ml beef stock and 1 tbsp cornflour.
W: the dance-off that saves the galaxy
Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with hot fudge of dark chocolate melted into cream, rainbow sprinkles, whipped cream and a sparkler for the final move.
K: A spoon of grenadine in the bottom of each glass, then lemonade over ice, then blue raspberry cordial poured slowly down a spoon so it layers like a nebula.

s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and bake at 220C for 45 minutes. Simmer 150g blackberries with 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, a crushed garlic clove and chilli flakes until sticky, then strain. Toss the wings through.

m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with 1 tbsp smoked paprika and 2 tbsp brown sugar. Wrap and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Unwrap, brush with 150ml barbecue sauce and glaze under the grill. Serve with 4 grilled corn cobs and slaw.

w.note: the dance-off that saves the galaxy
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate into 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into tall glasses, pour over the fudge, add whipped cream and rainbow sprinkles. Light a sparkler for the final move.

d.how: Put a spoon of grenadine in the bottom of each of four glasses. Fill with ice and lemonade, then pour blue raspberry cordial slowly down a spoon so it layers like a nebula.
